subject: Genetics
title: Turner and Klinefelter Syndromes
description: A fast breakdown of Turner and Klinefelter Syndromes for builders.

hook.text: Turner syndrome: one X, no second sex chromosome. Klinefelter: two X's plus a Y. Sex chromosomes vary.

discovery.text: Both are common. Klinefelter affects 1 in 600 males. Many go undiagnosed for decades or forever.

twist.text: Most people with these conditions lead normal lives. The syndromes are common, mild, and deeply underrecognized.

climax.text: Sex chromosome variations show biology is more nuanced than XX/XY. Nature doesn't always follow the textbook.

punchline.text: Sex chromosomes vary more than textbooks admit.
